description: Fetches a subreddit's moderator team by name (Reddit's /r/<name>/about/moderators data). Returns a `moderators` list, each with `name`, `id`, `mod_permissions`, `flair_text`, and `added` (when they joined the mod team). Example: name='python'.

name.description: Subreddit name WITHOUT the r/ prefix (e.g. 'python'). Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_subreddit_moderators
